description: Validate an EU VAT number live against the European Commission VIES service: valid/invalid, plus registered trader name and address where the member state discloses them. Accepts IE6388047V style input or ?country= + number; GR is mapped to EL, XI = Northern Ireland. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eu-vat-validate

country.description: Optional 2-letter member state code when vat has no prefix

vat.description: VAT number with 2-letter prefix (spaces/dots allowed), e.g. IE6388047V, DE 811569869
